import sys
import math

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    p = [[int(data[1 + i * n + j]) / 100.0 for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    
    no = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            if not ((mask >> i) & 1):
                no[i] |= (1 << mask)

    current = {1: 1.0}  # dict with key as long long, value as double
    for i in range(n):
        next_state = {}
        for state_key, state_val in current.items():
            for j in range(1 << n):
                prob = 1.0
                res = 0
                for k in range(n):
                    if (j & (1 << k)):
                        prob *= p[i][k]
                        res |= ( (state_key & no[k]) ) << (1 << k)
                    else:
                        prob *= (1 - p[i][k])
                next_state[res] = next_state.get(res, 0) + state_val * prob
        current = next_state

    result = current.get((1 << n) - 1, 0.0)
    print(f"{result:.9f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
